title: Gambling Change Persons and Booth Cashiers
description: Exchange coins, tokens, and chips for patrons' money. May issue payoffs and obtain customer's signature on receipt. May operate a booth in the slot machine area and furnish change persons with money bank at the start of the shift, or count and audit money in drawers.

projection.title: Gambling change persons and booth cashiers

tasks.text: Keep accurate records of monetary exchanges, authorization forms, and transaction reconciliations.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain structured sales records via tools

dwas.name: Maintain records of sales or other business transactions.

tasks.text: Exchange money, credit, tickets, or casino chips and make change for customers.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Transaction processing software-driven; human handles exceptions

tasks.text: Count money and audit money drawers.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Transaction accuracy checks are rule-based and reliable

dwas.name: Review accuracy of sales or other transactions.
Reconcile records of sales or other financial transactions.

tasks.text: Check identifications to verify age of players.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Document validity check aided, human verifies authenticity

dwas.name: Examine personal documentation to ensure that it is valid.

tasks.text: Maintain cage security according to rules.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Security monitoring of work areas needs physical presence

dwas.name: Monitor work areas to provide security.

tasks.text: Reconcile daily summaries of transactions to balance books.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Reconciling transaction records is rule-based matching

dwas.name: Reconcile records of sales or other financial transactions.

tasks.text: Obtain customers' signatures on receipts when winnings exceed the amount held in a slot machine.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Drafting aided; authorized signature human

dwas.name: Obtain written authorization to perform activities.

tasks.text: Calculate the value of chips won or lost by players.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Gaming win/loss computation from records

dwas.name: Compute gaming wins and losses.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Accept credit applications and verify credit references to provide check-cashing authorization or to establish house credit accounts.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Credit data screening against criteria, human decides

tasks.text: Furnish change persons with a money bank at the start of each shift.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Issuing money or vouchers often physical and accountable

tasks.text: Listen for jackpot alarm bells and issue payoffs to winners.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Issuing money or vouchers often physical and accountable

tasks.text: Sell gambling chips, tokens, or tickets to patrons, or to other workers for resale to patrons.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Closing sales requires persuasion and accountability
physical manipulation — Hands-on cleaning of work areas
